from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowItem(BaseModel):
    """A cash flow line item extracted from one financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name, e.g. '洋河股份'")
    item_name: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written, e.g. '销售商品、提供劳务收到的现金'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount value")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2022年第一季度', '2023年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the item and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_items: list[CashFlowItem]
